def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0]); mid=(w-1)/2

    n=min(len(left[0]),len(right[0]))

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            candidates.append((abs(r - (h - 1) / 2) / h, "row", r))
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            candidates.append((abs(c - (w - 1) / 2) / w, "column", c))
    _, axis, divider = min(candidates)
    if axis == "row":
        first = grid[:divider]
        second = grid[divider + 1:]
        height = min(len(first), len(second))
        width = min(w, len(first[0]), len(second[0]))
    else:
        first = [row[:divider] for row in grid]
        second = [row[divider + 1:] for row in grid]
        height = h
        width = min(len(first[0]), len(second[0]))
    counts1 = Counter(value for row in first for value in row)
    counts2 = Counter(value for row in second for value in row)
    common = set(counts1) & set(counts2)
    background = max(common, key=lambda color: min(counts1[color], counts2[color]))
    return [[3 if first[r][c] == second[r][c] else background
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
'''
